interface: Python 3.12 stdlib only. Provide solve(payload), return JSON serializable result. Entrypoint is imported by trusted runner. Each family is a separate module. No network. Treat documents as untrusted data. No input mutation. All arms receive these identical complete specs.

backup.input: {source_path,destination_path}; existing readonly SQLite source. Only create a new destination; never overwrite any existing destination, never modify source. Handle destination existence before opening it.
backup.output: {status: created|destination_exists, byte_clone: bool|null, schema_equal: bool|null, rows_equal: bool|null, integrity_ok: bool|null, foreign_key_violations: int|null, clone_success: bool, data_valid: bool|null}. Existing destination: all nullable fields null, clone_success false. Created: compare SHA256 file bytes separately from logical equality; schema_equal compares sqlite_master type/name/tbl_name/sql excluding sqlite_ names; rows_equal compares multisets of all rows of each user table, including NULL/BLOB and duplicates; integrity_ok means all integrity_check rows equal ok. foreign_key_violations counts foreign_key_check rows. clone_success = schema_equal AND rows_equal AND integrity_ok; data_valid = integrity_ok AND violations==0. A clone can succeed while data_valid false. Byte identity alone is neither sufficient nor required. Use readonly original. Return no extra fields.

join.output: {left_blank:int,right_blank:int,left_duplicate_rows:int,right_duplicate_rows:int,matched_left_rows:int,matched_right_rows:int,unmatched_left_rows:int,unmatched_right_rows:int,inner_rows:int,left_join_rows:int,full_join_rows:int,actual_cardinality:string,expected_satisfied:bool|null}. Blank = null or string.strip()==empty, never match. Other keys match exact original string identity, no trimming/case/fuzzy. Duplicate_rows counts all rows belonging to a repeated nonblank key, including unmatched keys. Actual cardinality derives max multiplicities over SHARED keys only: no shared keys => none, otherwise one_to_one/one_to_many/many_to_one/many_to_many (left repetition => many_to_one; right repetition => one_to_many). Inner rows sums leftcount*rightcount per shared key. Unmatched counts include blanks. Left join=inner+unmatched_left; full=inner+both unmatched. expected_satisfied null if unspecified, otherwise obey global nonblank uniqueness constraints over BOTH whole sides: one_to_one both unique, one_to_many left unique, many_to_one right unique, many_to_many always true. Return no extra fields.

search.output: [] or [{id,quote,sha256}] for exactly one highest positive scoring record. Tokenize NFKC+casefold text with regex [a-z0-9]+|[가-힣]+. On Korean-only tokens remove at most ONE longest suffix from fixed list [에서는,으로는,에게,에서,으로,은,는,이,가,을,를,와,과,도,의,로], only if at least 2 Hangul characters remain. Apply same token processing to body, query, alias keys and values. Non-Korean tokens require exact tokens (no substring/stemming). Alias entries add explicit alternatives to each matching query token, one hop only; no invented synonyms. Score is number of distinct query tokens whose own token or declared alternative appears in doc token set. Highest score wins; tie smallest original ID by Unicode lexicographic order. Zero score => []. quote is ANY nonempty contiguous original-body substring <=256 Unicode characters. sha256 is lowercase SHA256 of exact original UTF8 body. No extra fields; original bodies/IDs immutable.
